calendar_items.title: Lunch menu change week of May 11

telegram_summary: Lunch menu change week of May 11: Mon chicken nuggets → fish sticks, Tue chicken teriyaki → beef teriyaki, Wed chicken Caesar → turkey Caesar. Thu-Fri unchanged. Salad bar still available daily.
why_it_matters: Only relevant if your kids eat school lunch and you care about the specific menu, especially if they have dietary restrictions or are picky about the substituted items.
